correctness.rationale: The original graph has an exhaustive orthogonal projector decomposition with eigenvalues 0, N, N-n_r. Fractional powers yield exactly the new within-part conductances beta N^(alpha-1)(a_r^alpha-a_r)/(1-a_r). For the scaled graph, projector eigenvalues are 0,N,N e_r. The quadratic Heun polynomial is strictly positive on nonnegative real arguments; all diagonal matrix entries are positive. Cross-part entries equal t(1-t/2)/N, and same-part entries equal t[(e_r-a_r)-t(e_r^2-a_r)/2]/[N(1-a_r)]. These affine sign tests prove the exact interval and no recovery. Strict increase of c_alpha via weighted AM-GM proves the beta threshold. The largest internal eigenmode proves strict positivity-versus-spectral separation when beta exceeds the threshold. Exact-rational matrix replay: 2162 cases; fractional spectral reconstruction: 24 cases; universal conclusions rest on the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 source explicitly motivates scaling missing-edge fractional conductances to recover nonlocal transport; determining when that same scaling destroys second-order numerical mass positivity is a natural, consequential parameter-design problem. The exact beta_* governed by smallest nonsingleton part and sharp h_* for all alpha, beta and multipartite partitions are a complete classification, not an arbitrary finite slice. Strict separation between scalar spectral stability and positivity supplies a useful caution and a concrete negative transition witness for every forbidden timestep; no broader PDE claim is needed to justify the precise numerical fact.
